scripts.dev: concurrently -n app,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w app" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w design-system && npm run build -w app && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w design-system && npm test -w app && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w design-system && npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w server
